mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to compressed discount rates and increased equity valuation, as observed in the current rate of 0.07%.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% within the last 3 months signals economic deterioration, increasing equity risk premiums and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals severe economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% AND INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), the S&P 500 is overvalued due to economic maturity, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as observed in the current HOUST value of 880.0.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is above its 50th percentile.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals economic contraction, increasing equity risk and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index (CPIAUCSL) above 250 signals high inflation, triggering monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as observed in the current CPI value of 234.933.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction of strong housing starts (HOUST > 900) and robust retail sales (RSAFS > 400000) signals a consumer-driven economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 900 AND RSAFS > 400000.
